job.purpose: Actual prior GRT has one residual M2 and one M5 overflow edge; widen and deepen the real tile to increase both routing capacities and pin reserve; no source/clock/phase change.

benches.name: smmv_l0_xpt_exact
benches.cmd: set -o pipefail; FUSE=1 PROGRAM=0 J=16 DEFS='-DXBD +define+NCL=4 +define+WVM8 +define+XQ=3 +define+WIN=8 +define+XP +define+XPT +define+SMMV_DE=1' bash rtl/hbm_accel/generic/adapters/tb/run_smmv_tput.sh ds {RUN}/bench/smmv_l0_xpt_exact '' +WD=200000; grep -aE 'summary:|TOTAL|HGI_SMMV_TPUT' {RUN}/bench/smmv_l0_xpt_exact/run.log; grep -q 'HGI_SMMV_TPUT PASS' {RUN}/bench/smmv_l0_xpt_exact/run.log

benches.name: smmv_l0_xpt_wdrop_mutant
benches.cmd: set -o pipefail; FUSE=1 PROGRAM=0 J=16 DEFS='-DXBD +define+NCL=4 +define+WVM8 +define+XQ=3 +define+WIN=8 +define+XP +define+XPT +define+SMMV_DE=1' bash rtl/hbm_accel/generic/adapters/tb/run_smmv_tput.sh ds {RUN}/bench/smmv_l0_xpt_wdrop_mutant 'MUT_WDROP' +WD=200000; grep -aE 'summary:|TOTAL|HGI_SMMV_TPUT' {RUN}/bench/smmv_l0_xpt_wdrop_mutant/run_MUT_WDROP.log; grep -q 'HGI_SMMV_TPUT PASS' {RUN}/bench/smmv_l0_xpt_wdrop_mutant/run_MUT_WDROP.log
